title: Integral representative of the normalized scalar tower
statement: Let l be prime, E,F,G finite extensions of Q_l, i:E→F and j:F→G coefficient embeddings, and X a noetherian finite-dimensional l-invertible scheme. For normalized realizations aE,aF,aG and FieldChange records bEF,bFG,bEG [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data], assume their coefficient maps satisfy bEF.coefficient≫bFG.coefficient=bEG.coefficient. For each integral bounded constructible complete object K, the equation defining FieldComposition.compatibility holds at its raw rationalization QK, with the prescribed pbcRationalScalarCompComponent and pbcReductionNormalization. This is only a component equation on integral representatives; it constructs no raw comparison and assumes no natural transformation on a family of fields.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2), Remark 6.8.15; Stacks Tags 0D6D, 0A0E and 0A0G. Expansion of the normalized comparison argument.

proof.text: Postcompose the desired equation with extension along the composite rational coefficient map of the integral comparison, followed by the canonical reduction normalization. This map is invertible, so cancellation is legitimate.

On the direct side substitute bEG.integral_normalization. The prescribed rational associator is the rationalization of the actual integral tensor associator. Naturality of aG.integral moves this associator through the integral comparison.

On the iterated side use naturality of the reduction normalization and its associativity for the three maps integral-E→rational-E→rational-F→rational-G. Substitute bEF.integral_normalization, then use associativity for integral-E→integral-F→rational-F→rational-G. Substitute bFG.integral_normalization. The last associativity equation for integral-E→integral-F→integral-G→rational-G identifies the result with the direct side. Cancel the invertible postcomposition.

proof_origin.place: H8 expansion of BS Remark 6.8.15 into ambient tensor calculations and integral unit cancellation.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousIntegralScalarTower (i : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] F) (j : F →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] G)
    (X : Base.{u} l) (aE : At l E X) (aF : At l F X) (aG : At l G X)
    (bEF : FieldChange l E F i X aE aF) (bFG : FieldChange l F G j X aF aG)
    (bEG : FieldChange l E G (j.comp i) X aE aG)
    (hc : bEF.coefficient ≫ bFG.coefficient = bEG.coefficient)
    (K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete X.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) :
    aG.J.map (pbcRationalScalarCompComponent l E F G i j X.scheme
        X.dimension X.prime_unit
        ((pbcRationalization X.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K)).hom ≫
      bEG.comparison.hom.app
        ((pbcRationalization X.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K) =
    bFG.comparison.hom.app
        ((pbcRationalScalarExtension l E F i X.scheme X.dimension X.prime_unit).obj
          ((pbcRationalization X.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K)) ≫
      (pbcDerivedExtend bFG.coefficient).map (bEF.comparison.hom.app
        ((pbcRationalization X.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K)) ≫
      (pbcReductionNormalization bEF.coefficient bFG.coefficient bEG.coefficient
        hc (aE.J.obj
          ((pbcRationalization X.scheme (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E)).obj K))).hom
